summary: Include the Oracle Thick-mode image by default for approved releases.
userImpact: The standard Release Please publication dispatch queues the exact Oracle image without a separate selection or dispatch.
configuration: Set publish_oracle_image=false only for a release that has an approved exception.
security: The exact-source release approval, Oracle qualification, scans, signatures, and receipt verification still apply.

customerDocumentation.reason: The change sets a release workflow default and preserves the image reference and runtime configuration contracts.

knownLimitations: The signed Oracle publication receipt confirms registry availability after the separate qualification run.
rollback: Use the release dispatch's explicit Oracle opt-out for an approved exception.
validation: Verify default-on selection for an approved publication and confirm that an opt-out or preparation dispatch does not authorize Oracle publication.
